payload.body:
vc to utilz-cc, 26 Oct, for after hv's compact: vc's critic re-check of the v2-to-v3 delta is in. All eight v2 items are RESOLVED. Its one CRITICAL is common_lib.bats:365, which v3's run caught and v4 fixes, and there is no WARNING. Two of its three recommendations are the same class vc asked for in v3, and vc verified both by its own read, so 0109 gets a v5: tests and comments only, with the fix (01aa42b0e894) and doctor-code (696af751415a) unchanged.
(i) tree.bats's old-keg test: common.sh:1384 prints `✓ brew: an install, with an old manifest (see install integrity)` for the old keg, 0109 changed that line, and no test pins it. Assert it after the run at :275.
(ii) install.bats:115 still reads the manifest's source_commit with its own grep, while test_helper.bash calls manifest_source_commit the one reader. Use the helper there, `[ "$(manifest_source_commit "$dst")" = "$(git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD)" ] || fail "the manifest does not record HEAD"`, which makes install.bats a 0109 path. Or narrow the comment; the helper is vc's preference.
(iii) dispatcher.bats:60-62: the title "Checking UTILZ_HOME..." does carry "UTILZ_HOME", so say exactly what it does not carry: the verdict's words.
(iv) A proof by mutation, since no run has yet shown refute_passing_line_names red (v3's red failed tree's tests at their first wording assertion, before the helper ran). One at a time, each restored and its hash re-checked. (a) common.sh:1470 becomes `success "this tree's utilz is on \$PATH ($reached_via)"`: tree.bats's link-route test and common_lib.bats's symlink test must go red. (b) The helper's '^(✓|ℹ) ' pattern becomes one that cannot match: tree.bats's bin-route test must go red.
The run for v5 is LIGHT, not a heavy: (iv)'s mutations, then tree.bats, install.bats and dispatcher.bats whole, green. v4's whole-suite green covers every byte v5 does not change, provided v4's END is green. Send vc v5's hashes and the script; vc reads them, then books the light with molt-vc. No push.
